evaluable_candidate_definition.classification: Harness-contained candidate runtime exceptions during evaluation remain evaluable (is_valid=True) with bounded error traces recorded for optimizer feedback. Candidate top-level import/syntax failures and attributable process termination (CandidateProcessError) score (0, 10) with is_valid=False. Any live-worker CandidateTimeoutError, unattributed wall-clock timeout, or infrastructure fault invalidates the attempt, not a scored candidate.
evaluable_candidate_definition.denominator: Total candidate generation calls (baseline + optimizer + control)
evaluable_candidate_definition.numerator: Number of candidate generation calls where candidate imported cleanly and completed a scored test harness evaluation without process death, worker timeout, or evaluation-aborting infrastructure failure

exploratory_secondaries: score-improving mutations per optimizer mutation call
mutation depth producing each new best
known_limitations: Modest power; ten randomized trial blocks; narrow guided-vs-unguided claim only.
Estimand is the service presented as gpt-5.6-sol during the campaign window; silent provider changes undetectable.
CLI JSONL is strictly parsed and correlation-bound, not cryptographically authenticated.
One-shot enforcement is local, cooperative-operator threat model; the remote anchors definition only.
No hard token or cost bound; post-call ceiling with possible one-call overshoot.
Trial timeouts are accepted-risk thresholds, not worst-case.
Claims cover the eight fixed preregistered confirmatory tasks, not unseen tasks generally.
Tiers balanced by structural task FAMILY, not measured difficulty; families are not difficulty strata.
MacBook memory availability is not a production containment guarantee; accepted for this non-adversarial research campaign.
A candidate that blocks without consuming CPU produces an unattributed wall-clock timeout and invalidates the attempt; phase-based exit attribution does not cover non-exiting processes.
A >= 0.05 is an observed practical gate, not inferential proof of absolute improvement.

prompt_envelope.control_reformulation_text:
Rewrite the strategy section of this prompt using different wording.
Do not change the meaning or intent. Keep it concise.
prompt_envelope.immutable_contract:
You are an expert Python coder. Your job is to solve the programming task described in the input.
You must output ONLY valid Python code inside a markdown block starting with ```python and ending with ```.
Do not write explanations, markdown text, or any formatting outside the code block.
Write the code to implement the requested functions or classes exactly as specified.
If any exceptions are requested, define them as standard Exception subclasses.
Write clean, correct, and self-contained code.
